_comment: Variant override for the Extractor build, merged onto base tauri.conf.json at build time via `tauri build --config tauri.extractor.conf.json` (the plan's 'four build targets, one core' — see TASK_27 Part A §Build/release pipeline). Only what GENUINELY differs per variant is set here: productName, identifier, and the bundle icon/target deviations. The Next.js app also reads BUILD_TARGET=extractor to gate which routes/nav compile in.
